diagrams.name: C4 System Context
diagrams.mavissConvention: Groups internal services into a single system boundary; exposes external systems and integrations. Internal microservice-to-microservice calls and Compose startup arrows are excluded.
extractors: DockerDetectorServiceImpl (external service references)
JavaSourceParser (outbound HTTP client integrations)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (HttpClient / external service integrations)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/architecture.test.cjs (System Context groups internal elements and excludes Compose startup arrows; context remains visible without actors and never promotes internal infrastructure to external systems)
diagrams.limitations: MAVISS does not fabricate human actors; when an external boundary is extracted without an identified user actor, the diagram presents the software system boundaries truthfully without invented actor stubs.

diagrams.name: C4 Container
diagrams.mavissConvention: Draws a named System Boundary containing owned internal service containers, logical datastores, and message channels. External systems stay outside. Preserves verified messaging and database protocols in labels.
extractors: DockerDetectorServiceImpl (docker-compose services, dependencies, datasource, message broker)
SpringConfigDetectorServiceImpl (application.yml/properties datasource and broker configuration)
JavaSourceParser (Kafka/Tram messaging endpoints)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (ASP.NET Core controllers and messaging)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/architecture.test.cjs (C4 Container draws a named system boundary around owned containers; boundary header and legend scale; messaging labels append channel protocol only from channel properties)
MAVIS-Frontend/tests/edge-semantics.test.cjs (real producer database protocol wire mapping to Draw.io XML label)
diagrams.limitations: M1 round-trip metadata preservation verified. Drag/undo/redo remains NEEDS MANUAL VERIFICATION per baseline constraint (D5).

diagrams.name: C4 Component
diagrams.mavissConvention: Scopes to a single selected service container. Nests internal controllers, services, repositories under the service boundary; retains connections to external queues/databases and other services while excluding fine-grained CLASS_INTERFACE nodes so C3 stays strictly component-scoped.
extractors: JavaSourceParser (Spring stereotype annotations: @Controller, @RestController, @Service, @Repository)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (ASP.NET ControllerBase, Service, Repository classes)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/architecture.test.cjs (FTGO component scope selects populated service and distinguishes infrastructure with no internals)
MAVIS-Frontend/tests/uml-m4-m8.test.cjs (C4 C3 Component view excludes CLASS_INTERFACE nodes)
diagrams.limitations: Available for services with AST-parsed components (e.g. Spring and ASP.NET Core services).

diagrams.name: UML Class Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Renders 3-compartment classifiers (CLASS, ABSTRACT_CLASS, INTERFACE, ENUM, RECORD, STRUCT) with AST-verified type kinds (never guessing interfaces from 'I' prefix), visibility symbols (+, -, #, ~) with explicit language-specific labels (~ [package-private] in Java vs ~ [internal] in C#), overloaded operations keyed by full parameter signature, and deduplicated structural relationships (GENERALIZATION, REALIZATION, ASSOCIATION, DEPENDENCY). Enforces whole-part restraint: static fields never fabricate SHARED_AGGREGATION or COMPOSITION (supported in DESIGNED overlay mode).
extractors: JavaSourceParser (JavaParser AST ClassOrInterfaceDeclaration, EnumDeclaration, RecordDeclaration, fields, constructors, overloaded methods, generics)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (Roslyn Class/Interface/Record/Struct/Enum declarations, properties, fields, overloaded methods, generics)
GraphBuilderServiceImpl & ArchitectureResolver (persists CLASS_INTERFACE elements and umlRelationKind edge properties)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/connected-pipeline.test.cjs (Java and C# Class Diagram projection & 2-cycle Draw.io round-trip)

rules.name: AST-Verified Classifier Kind & 3-Compartment Rendering (No 'I'-Prefix Guessing; Overloads Keyed by Signature)
Visibility Symbols (+, -, #, ~) with Language-Explicit ~ [package-private] (Java) vs ~ [internal] (C#)
Relationship Precedence & Whole-Part Restraint (Suppress Redundant Dependency when Association Exists; No Fabricated Aggregation/Composition from Static Fields)
Honest Multiplicity (Omit UNKNOWN Static Multiplicity; Explicit 1..*, 0..1, * Supported in DESIGNED Overlay)

diagrams.limitations: Static source extraction never guesses runtime object lifetime ownership (Aggregation/Composition) or exact multiplicity bounds; architects can author Composition/Aggregation and multiplicities via DESIGNED overlay.

diagrams.name: UML Sequence Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Visualizes ordered message occurrences across lifelines (services, components, channels, datastores, external systems, designed roles) using canonical mavis-interaction/v2 contract. Supports Lifelines (SEQ-N01, never underlined), MessageSorts & Provenance (SEQ-N02: SYNCH_CALL, ASYNCH_CALL, ASYNCH_SIGNAL, REPLY, CREATE, DELETE, UNKNOWN, self-call; static edges/transport fields remain UNKNOWN until confirmed), ExecutionSpecifications (SEQ-N03 including nested activations & collision-free IDs), CombinedFragments & InteractionUses (SEQ-N04: alt, opt, loop, par, ref frames, plus break/critical/strict as DESIGNED_ONLY), and Ordering/Causality/Relationship Disambiguation (SEQ-N05: Kahn causal topological sort, CLIENT/SERVER span deduplication, sorted candidateRelationshipIds).
extractors: OtelTraceCorrelationServiceImpl (distributed trace span trees, CLIENT/SERVER span deduplication, internal CLIENT span causal stitching, clock-skew detection, candidateRelationshipIds disambiguation)
RunnerReceiptIngestServiceImpl (runtime receipt correlation with base/enriched canonical element & relationship IDs)
scenario-design.ts (mavis-interaction/v2 validator, V0 mavisScenario migration, Kahn causal observed projection, Draw.io XML generator & strict layout-only round-trip conflict detector)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/connected-pipeline.test.cjs (live Java observed sequence artifact to frontend projection and Draw.io XML)
MAVIS-Frontend/tests/architecture.test.cjs (Designed scenarios preserve explicit order, repeats and canonical IDs across XML export and reload)

rules.name: Lifeline & Participant Header («stereotype» role:Name, non-underlined)
Message Sorts & Provenance Honesty (SYNCH_CALL, ASYNCH_CALL, ASYNCH_SIGNAL, REPLY, CREATE, DELETE, UNKNOWN, self-message)
ExecutionSpecification (Activation Bars & Nested Activations + Lifecycle Validation)
CombinedFragment & InteractionUse (alt, opt, loop, par, ref = PRODUCTION_READY; break, critical, strict = DESIGNED_ONLY)
Ordering, Causality & Canonical Relationship Disambiguation (Kahn topological sort, candidateRelationshipIds, Draw.io layout-only conflict detection)

diagrams.limitations: 1) Single observed traces do not auto-infer alt/opt/loop CombinedFragments (requires 'Create designed copy' HYBRID authoring). 2) OTel span endTime never fabricates synthetic REPLY messages. 3) Operators break/critical/strict are supported as DESIGNED_ONLY with semantic warning; found/lost border gate messages are DEFERRED. 4) M3-AC09 live observed browser trace is BLOCKED due to 0 runtime_sessions in PostgreSQL (synthetic trace correlation & projection verified in Java/FE integration tests).

diagrams.name: UML Package Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Projects qualified Java packages and C# namespaces as tabbed UML Package folders (shape=folder), aggregates cross-package classifier dependencies while preserving all underlying canonical relationship IDs and evidence IDs, and validates cyclic «merge» relationships (PACKAGE_MERGE_CYCLE_DETECTED) and cross-service package collisions.
extractors: JavaSourceParser (package declaration, imports, classifier ownership)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (namespace declaration, using directives, classifier ownership)
uml-diagrams.ts (projectUmlPackageDiagram, cross-package dependency aggregation, cycle & collision validators)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/connected-pipeline.test.cjs (Java and C# Package Diagram projection & 2-cycle Draw.io round-trip)

rules.name: Tabbed Package Folder Rendering & Nested Member Listing (Java package / C# namespace)
Cross-Package Dependency Aggregation with Full Underlying Edge & Evidence Preservation
Package Stereotype & «merge» Cycle Validator (PACKAGE_MERGE_CYCLE_DETECTED)

diagrams.limitations: Extracted cross-package relationships default to dashed «use»/dependency arrows; «import», «access», and «merge» stereotypes are authored via DESIGNED overlay.

diagrams.name: UML Deployment Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Projects 3D UML Deployment Nodes («executionEnvironment» and «device» with shape=cube), nested «artifact» nodes, dashed «manifest» arrows to manifested logical components/services, and solid «communicationPath» links derived strictly from protocol-evidenced runtime/static communication edges. Docker Compose depends_on edges are excluded from CommunicationPath (optional «depends_on (startup only)» overlay). Enforces single-environment isolation per diagram.
extractors: DockerDetectorServiceImpl (docker-compose services, container_name, image, ports, environment, depends_on)
GraphBuilderServiceImpl & ArchitectureResolver (deploymentMetadata persistence on SERVICE_CONTAINER, DATABASE, QUEUE_BROKER)
uml-diagrams.ts (projectUmlDeploymentDiagram, CommunicationPath vs Compose depends_on separation, environment filter)

rules.name: 3D Deployment Nodes («executionEnvironment», «device»), Nested «artifact», and «manifest» Edges
CommunicationPath Honesty (Compose depends_on Excluded from CommunicationPath; Optional Startup Dependency Overlay)
Environment Isolation (No Multi-Environment Mixing Within a Single Deployment Diagram)

diagrams.limitations: Physical bare-metal server topology outside Docker Compose / Spring configuration is not auto-discovered and can be added via DESIGNED «device» nodes.

diagrams.name: UML Activity Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Extracts intra-method AST Control Flow Graphs (CFG) in Java (JavaParser) and C# (Roslyn) and renders them inside a service-scoped Swimlane ActivityPartition. Supports InitialNode, Action, DecisionNode, MergeNode, ForkNode, JoinNode (joinSpec=AND), ObjectNode ([state]), ActivityFinal, and FlowFinal. Enforces the Decision/Merge vs Fork/Join deadlock validator (JOIN_BRANCH_DEADLOCK) and marks methods containing lambdas/closures/exception handlers or abstract bodies as PARTIAL (ACTIVITY_CFG_PARTIAL).
extractors: JavaSourceParser (extractMethodCfg: IfStmt -> Decision/Merge, While/For -> loop Decision/Merge, ReturnStmt -> ActivityFinal, ThrowStmt -> FlowFinal)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (ExtractMethodCfg: IfStatementSyntax, While/For/ForEach, ReturnStatementSyntax, ThrowStatementSyntax)
uml-diagrams.ts (projectUmlActivityDiagram, validateActivityStructure including JOIN_BRANCH_DEADLOCK)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/connected-pipeline.test.cjs (Java and C# Activity Diagram projection & 2-cycle Draw.io round-trip)

rules.name: Method-Level AST CFG Extraction (Java & C#) with Service Swimlane Partitioning
Control Node Semantics & Fork/Join vs Decision/Merge Deadlock Validator (JOIN_BRANCH_DEADLOCK)
Honest PARTIAL Completeness Marker for Lambdas, Exception Handlers, and Unexpanded Bodies (ACTIVITY_CFG_PARTIAL)

diagrams.limitations: AST extraction is scoped per method/operation; cross-service distributed workflows are modeled in UML Sequence or via DESIGNED Activity nodes.

diagrams.name: UML State Machine Diagram
diagrams.mavissConvention: Extracts entity/processor state lifecycles in Java and C# across two explicit modes: (1) STATEFUL_CLASS mode extracts state-carrier fields, initial state, and method guard/assignment transitions formatted as trigger [guard] / effect; (2) ENUM_DECLARATION mode extracts state literals only and strictly refuses to fabricate transitions (ENUM_ONLY_NO_TRANSITIONS) unless authored in DESIGNED mode. Enforces structural validators (single Initial per region, triggerless Initial transition, FinalState with 0 outgoing transitions, Choice branches with guards and no triggers).
extractors: JavaSourceParser (extractStateLifecycle for stateful classes with enum state fields and enum declarations)
CSharpSourceAnalyzer (ExtractStateLifecycle for stateful classes/properties and enum declarations)
uml-diagrams.ts (projectUmlStateDiagram, validateStateStructure, formatTransitionLabel)
validators: MAVIS-Frontend/tests/connected-pipeline.test.cjs (Java and C# State Machine projection & 2-cycle Draw.io round-trip)

rules.name: Stateful Class Transition Extraction with Canonical trigger [guard] / effect Formatting
Enum-Only Transition Restraint (ENUM_ONLY_NO_TRANSITIONS — Never Fabricate Transitions from Enum Literals Alone)
State Machine Structural Validators (Single Initial, Triggerless Initial/Choice, Guarded Choice, Terminal FinalState)

diagrams.limitations: Enum declarations without a stateful class mutating an enum field do not invent transitions automatically (requires DESIGNED transitions).
